title: Telegram requester text input on REQUESTER screen
requirements: Add a pure TelegramScreenActionResolver (or equally narrow name) accepting only exact mapper-produced TEXT_INPUT TelegramIntent and exact ConversationResult preflight shapes.

Revalidate exact immutable intent shape: TELEGRAM context, TEXT_INPUT kind, MappingProxyType payload exactly {text}, no callback id, normalized non-empty text up to 4096 characters. Reject forged or mutable payloads with typed safe INVALID_INTENT.

For exact preflight screen REQUESTER and the accepted current draft form, return immutable ChannelAction(SET_REQUESTER, {name: text}) with name only and no contact. Enforce ChannelConversation name limit 1..200; invalid requester text returns typed safe INVALID_REQUESTER_INPUT. Error str/repr never includes text or identifiers.

For every other screen, kind, result shape, malformed data or answers return typed safe SCREEN_INPUT_UNSUPPORTED or INVALID_SCREEN_RESULT before mutation. Never parse DETAILS, date, time, participants, experience, comment or commands, and never pass adapter_metadata into an action or outcome.

Inject the screen resolver as a strict dependency in TelegramConversationOrchestrator. TEXT_INPUT performs mapper, exactly one read-only OPEN preflight with the same exact context, screen resolver, then exactly one resolved conversation call and at most one mutation. Preserve exact mapper, screen-resolver and conversation error identity.

Keep existing OPEN/HELP/RESET/SUBMIT at one conversation call and SELECT_SERVICE at one OPEN preflight plus SELECT_SERVICE call using TelegramActionResolver; do not change callback behavior. Do not add contact from sender/chat, persist or log raw text, or perform transport/HTTP/SDK/env/retry/external calls. Do not change the coarse FSM or invent a DETAILS format. If REQUESTER results include catalog/answers, accept only the necessary agreed form.

Add exhaustive pure resolver tests for exact types, context/platform/kind, immutable and forged payloads, text boundaries 1/200/201/4096, whitespace/NUL, callback presence, malformed screen/result/data/answers and exact immutable action; add orchestrator ordering/context/callback/mutation/error-identity and regression coverage.
acceptance: Focused screen-action and conversation tests, all Telegram adapter/interaction/action/conversation regressions, complete pytest suite and git diff --check pass.
Actual diff stays within the approved allowed paths and makes no changes to the API, transport, persistence, web, packages, docs, config or existing coarse FSM contracts.

shared_paths_approval.reason: Add the narrowly scoped screen-aware Telegram requester action over the reviewed mapper and shared conversation contracts.
